_comment: Calls namespace: consultations, follow-ups, approvals, webinars and workshops. Serbian and Hungarian are drafts pending native speaker review.

policy.title: Follow-up approval
policy.intro: When an expert proposes a follow-up session and the employee confirms it, choose whether it is booked straight away or needs an approver first.
policy.label: Follow-up approval policy
policy.automaticBody: The session is booked as soon as the employee confirms it. Nobody else is asked.
policy.managerBody: The approver for the employee’s team decides before the session is booked. They see only the employee’s name, that it is a follow-up session with a NestSelf expert, the date and the length, never the topic or the expert. If no approver covers the employee’s team, the follow-up cannot be confirmed until you name one.
policy.saved: The follow-up approval policy is saved.
policy.loadFailedTitle: The policy could not be loaded
policy.sampleNote: Sample mode: your choice is not saved.
